## Summary

Describe the change and link the related issue.

## Validation evidence

List automated checks and, for promotion to `main`, the manual QA evidence (for example, test steps or screenshots).

## QA sign-off (required for promotion to `main`)

- [ ] I tested the change on the integrated `stage` branch, or documented why that does not apply to this setup change.
- [ ] I checked the relevant user flow, error cases, and regressions (or the workflow behavior for CI-only changes).

## Lead code review (required for promotion to `main`)

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff and checked it against the request.
- [ ] I checked maintainability, security-sensitive changes, and test coverage.

Solo-learning note: the QA and lead labels/checklists are self-attestations, not independent approvals.
